rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Ballistic Vest
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Bane
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Delayed Action
rules.description: Once per round, if your opponent has more units left to activate than you, then this model's unit may pass its turn instead of activating (may still be activated later).

rules.name: Enhanced Ballistic Vest
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Ballistic Vest, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Ballistic Vest (instead of only AP(-1)).

rules.name: Enhanced Ballistic Vest Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Ballistic Vest. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Fortified
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Fortified, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Fortified (instead of only AP(-1)).

rules.name: Flying
rules.description: May move through units and terrain, and ignores the effects of Difficult and Dangerous terrain it doesn’t start its move in.This unit automatically passes jumping rolls.

rules.name: Flying Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Flying. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Fortified
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Furious
rules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Furious Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Furious. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Melee Shrouding
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for charging, that enemy unit gets -2" range to a min. of 6".

rules.name: Melee Shrouding Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Piercing Target
rules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking them.

rules.name: Ranged Slayer
rules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Ranged Slayer Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ranged Slayer. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Relentless
rules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Repel Ambushers
rules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

rules.name: Slayer
rules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Smash
rules.description: When attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Surge
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Surge Mark
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Surge on their weapons when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Vanguard
rules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

spells.name: Absorption Amplifier
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Ballistic Vest once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Assign Bounty
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Surge on their weapons against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Choking Gas
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 3 hits with Bane.

spells.name: Stinger Blast
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 24" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with AP(1) and Smash.

spells.name: Targeting Signal
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Relentless once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Taser Shock
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with AP(2).
